about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-86: an amendment to R16a (XC-39, signed and done). R16a protects one property, that an unpaid HEAD never reaches the protected handler, but its pass condition accepted only a 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED, so a live server that refuses HEAD with 405 and `Allow: GET` (reproduced twice on 2026-10-25) was graded a failure although the handler is never reached. This widens the pass condition to that property: 402 with an offer, or 405 with no PAYMENT-RESPONSE. A 2xx still fails. The check id keeps its property; its name text changes to say so. The XC-39 criteria keep passing (six R16a tests remain, two are added). Owner's go, 2026-10-25T12:48Z, in chat: 'fix mcp and endpoints and then test'. Under D-AUTO-4 sys may batch-sign contracts covered by an owner go; nothing here binds until the owner key signs it into proofline.json.

tasks.title: R16a amendment: an unpaid HEAD refused with 405 never reaches the handler and passes
tasks.description: probeUnpaidHead passes when the unpaid HEAD is answered 402 with a decodable PAYMENT-REQUIRED offer, or 405 without PAYMENT-RESPONSE (the Allow header is recorded); 2xx, 3xx and any other answer fail as before. ts/example/head-unpaid-server.ts gains a head_refused variant (405, Allow: GET, handler never runs) as a second control on Solana devnet and Base Sepolia. probeUnpaidHead also takes { fetch, unpaidGetStatus } so a paced fetch and a shared unpaid GET can drive it against a live server. SPEC, FIXES and README text follow.

criteria.statement: R16a passes a router that refuses HEAD with 405 and Allow: GET, with the handler never run, on Solana devnet and Base Sepolia
